module_summary: Multi-cycle IEEE-754 single-precision multiplier: a free-running 3-bit step counter sequences unpack, special-case handling, subnormal pre-normalization, mantissa multiply/exponent add, guard/round/sticky extraction, normalize/round and pack into the 32-bit result.

anchors.name: n9_47f
anchors.why: Step counter sequencing the seven phases; every phase block is gated on its value.

anchors.name: n4_113
anchors.why: First float operand unpacked into sign, exponent and mantissa.

anchors.name: n11_144
anchors.why: Second float operand unpacked into sign, exponent and mantissa.

anchors.name: n18_dfc
anchors.why: Packed float product, or NaN/Inf/zero from special-case handling.

anchors.name: n5_c26
anchors.why: Operand mantissa with hidden bit, pre-normalized for subnormals before multiply.

anchors.name: n15_077
anchors.why: Unbiased operand exponent, checked for specials and adjusted during pre-normalization.

anchors.name: n8_4bb
anchors.why: Full mantissa product feeding result mantissa and guard/round/sticky bits.

anchors.name: n17_bde
anchors.why: Result mantissa normalized, denormal-shifted and rounded before packing.

anchors.name: n19_d34
anchors.why: Result exponent: sum of exponents, adjusted by normalization, rounding and underflow.

anchors.name: n14_7c6
anchors.why: Result sign, XOR of operand signs.

anchors.name: n12_cc4
anchors.why: Round bit; with guard and sticky decides round-up of mantissa.

anchors.name: n2_49c
anchors.why: Clears step counter, restarting the multiply sequence.

groups.name: step_sequencer
groups.description: Step counter decoding the seven multiply phases.

groups.name: unpack
groups.description: Operand mantissa, exponent and sign fields with subnormal pre-normalization.

groups.name: multiply_core
groups.description: Mantissa multiply, exponent add and sign XOR.

groups.name: normalize_round
groups.description: Normalize, denormalize, guard/round/sticky rounding of result mantissa.

groups.name: pack
groups.description: Packs result fields or special values into float output.
